reason: Canvas apps, flows, custom connector policies, Dataverse plugins, DAX, and Power Query must not own formula logic, pricing-year mapping rules, classification grouping rules, or source-bundle lookup rules.

violations.message: Formula logic was placed in Power Fx instead of the shared service boundary.
Pricing-year validation rules were duplicated in orchestration logic.

expected_remediation: Move calculation and validation semantics back to the shared calculator service and keep Power Platform assets to mapping, submission, status, diagnostics, and presentation.
